Area 1: Mapping — Garden of Sounds

These three prototypes explore how moving an object on screen can change musical pitch: through separate zones, continuous vertical movement, and a combination of notes and octaves.

Open a prototype to try it. Expand its commit log to see the recorded development history.

Drag the flower into the sky, garden, or underground, then release it to play a note from that zone.

Area 2: Feedback — Garden of Sounds

These three prototypes explore how the garden responds when a flower plays a sound: through movement, colour and glow, and ripples in the surrounding canvas.

Open a prototype to try it. Expand its commit log to see the recorded development history.

Tap the flower to play a note and watch it grow and bounce in time with the sound.
